title: Values within an unrolled stage
statement: Let a sequential circuit be unrolled for $T$ steps on input $x$, and let $k\le T$. Suppose that at stage $k$ every register vertex has the value prescribed by the sequential circuit's state at time $k$. Then for every vertex index $a<n+r+g$, the value at its placed vertex in the unrolled circuit equals the value at index $a$ when the combinational circuit is evaluated on the input together with the time-$k$ register state; here $g$ is the number of combinational gates.
hypotheses_covered: At each register vertex placed at stage $k$, the unrolled circuit's value equals that register's state at time $k$
